x: Jimmy Kemp, from Northern Ireland, where he says Army boots and plenty of work keep him out of running togs. Was very impressed by Dick Towndrows' win in the M'Connell Cup Race.

Jimmy Kemp, when on leave, paid us a visit at Belgrave Hall on 30th January, on the occasion of the match with the Metropolitan Police. He was full of smiles and looked very robust and although he turned out, was obviously short of training.
Jimmy Kemp sends a short, chatty letter from Wrotham, Kent. Len Spooner, now a Lieutenant, is at present in Palestine, and recently had an operation for hernia.
